messages:
incidents-bot: :rotating_light: PAGER (sev=1) — Smart-routing policy triggered a residency override for tenant 'AcmeCorp'. Traffic recorded in us-east-1 while tenant is EU-residency. Trace: trc_9f3a. Paging on-call SRE.

maya: ack — I'm oncall for eng-sre. Joining now.

samir: saw alerts; latency spikes and a handful of requests routed to us-east-1. Looks like fallback policy took precedence.

leah: I saw a noisy deploy earlier to smart-route v2-policy. Might be related. Can someone paste the policy snippet?

maya: grabbing config from prod: ```
policy id: smart-route-v2
rules:
  - match: region==EU
    primary: eu-west-1
    fallback: global
  - match: any
    primary: us-east-1
fallback_policy:
  precedence: proximity > cost > compliance
```

samir: oh. fallback precedence includes cost before compliance. That explains override when eu capacity low. Bad ordering.

ops-bot: deploy-notify: smart-route-v2 deployed by devops at 2028-03-15T08:02:12Z :rocket:

leah: confirmed — recent change removed the strict residency guard. Possibly accidental.

maya: immediate mitigation suggestion: flip precedence to enforce compliance before cost, and disable global fallback for residency-tagged tenants. Plan: 1) add emergency ACL to prevent cross-region routing for EU tenants 2) roll back smart-route-v2 to v1 3) notify security & affected customers.

security-oncall: on it — need list of affected requests and whether any payloads persisted outside EU. Prioritize data access audit.

support-jake: flagging support tickets for AcmeCorp and two other EU tenants that saw errors. I've drafted a short NV message.

samir: running query for routed traces: `select * from routing_log where trace='trc_9f3a' or policy='smart-route-v2' and timestamp > now()-1h` — returns ~132 requests for AcmeCorp, 9 of which included customer PII in logs (transient).

leah: how transient? persisted in S3?

samir: a subset wrote to debug-sink in us-east-1 due to misrouted debug logging. S3 path: s3://redwood-debug/us-east-1/2028-03-15/trc_9f3a. We're isolating objects.

maya: mitigation step 1: applying ACL rule now to block non-EU routes for tenants with residency=EU. Command: `redwoodctl routes update --policy smart-route-v2 --set \"fallback_policy.precedence=compliance,proximity,cost\"` then `redwoodctl routes patch --block-global-fallback --filter residency:EU`

ops-bot: command executed by maya at 1845000123 — response: 200 OK.

leah: also initiating rollback to smart-route-v1 for prod to be safe. Command: `redwoodctl deploy rollback smart-route --to v1 --env prod`

ops-bot: rollback started by leah at 1845000200 — stage: canary -> 10% traffic.

maya: notify security — please run audit on s3 bucket and freeze access keys used by debug-sink.

security-oncall: running object-list for prefix `2028-03-15/trc_9f3a` in s3://redwood-debug/us-east-1. Also creating a temporary retention hold and snapshot. Will provide location and hashes.

support-jake: I've sent interim message to AcmeCorp: "We detected routing to a non-EU region and are mitigating; no evidence of persistent customer-visible data exfiltration; we'll update in 90 minutes." :email:

samir: rollback to v1 completed to 100% at 1845000350. Traffic back to eu-west-1 for new requests.

maya: running post-rollback verification. `curl -H \"x-tenant: acmecorp\" https://api.redwood.ai/route-check` -> header shows `region=eu-west-1`. Good.

leah: double-checking older in-flight requests — we should invalidate any KV cache keys that could route old sessions to us-east-1. Command: `redwoodctl cache invalidate --match "tenant:acmecorp*"`

ops-bot: cache invalidate job queued by leah at 1845000420 — estimate 2 minutes.

security-oncall: found 4 objects in debug-sink with PII. Made copies to secure forensic bucket and issued deletion on original. Recording hashes: h1:abc123, h2:def456, h3:ghi789, h4:jkl012.

maya: add follow-up items: 1) revert policy change in config repo and add CI check for residency precedence 2) incident postmortem 3) customer notification template and potential credit.

samir: creating incident ticket: INC-2028-1845 with severity=security, linking traces and S3 artifacts.

support-jake: AcmeCorp responded asking for timeline and whether logs were accessible to humans — I told them we are performing a forensics review and will share findings under NDA if needed.

leah: handing off on-call to samir for next 30m while I finish rollback verification. Samir, you're primary.

samir: taking it. I'll follow through with security and run a broader query for other tenants.

incidents-bot: incident recorded: INC-2028-1845 — status: mitigation in-progress — assigned: samir — pager closed for immediate paging.

support-jake: scheduling customer follow-up at +90m.

security-oncall: will deliver initial forensic note in 60 minutes with list of objects, access logs, and whether keys were used externally.

maya: thanks all. Keep this thread for handoff notes. We'll meet for a postmortem tomorrow 09:00 UTC. :thumbsup:

samir: updating ticket with current timeline and steps taken. Closing loop when security confirms object deletion.

leah: leaving final note: root cause = routing policy precedence misconfiguration (cost > compliance), introduced in smart-route-v2 deploy. Remediation: config CI guard + config monitoring alert on residency overrides.

incidents-bot: incident update at 1845000845 — mitigation complete; verification passed; follow-ups created.
